title: The contract–tort boundary in punitive remedies
shortTitle: The contract–tort boundary in punitive remedies
summary: The historical notes discuss attempts to obtain tort remedies for conduct connected with contractual relations.
notes: The examples include insurance disputes and cases concerning alleged bad-faith denial of a contract. Subsequent qualifications to some decisions are part of the notes. Preserve the distinction between an independent wrong and a description of the breach as willful, malicious, or bad faith. The cited cases are not all interchangeable applications of White.

sources.label: Farnsworth et al., Contracts: Cases and Materials, 10th ed. (2023), pp. 33–34. Open assigned page 33.
